rulings.decision: Dedicated branch in the existing checkout, no implicit worktree
rulings.why: No worktree was requested; host instructions prohibit creating one implicitly
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Shared filesystem requires avoiding concurrent writers

rulings.why: It uses State.Apply but has no normal-history or OnResults forwarding
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An overlooked downstream consumer could still publish rejected data

rulings.decision: No trusted timestamp means no numeric observation in the public DTO
rulings.why: signal.Value's zero value is a legitimate numeric zero, not absence
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Consumers ignoring quality/time could still mistake an internal zero for a reading

rulings.decision: Do not invent provenance for undeclared producers
rulings.why: Only the existing Modbus success path can explicitly declare platform_collection here
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Other adapters need their own provenance work before claiming this contract

rulings.decision: Share query lifecycle and presentation, and key by device plus point
rulings.why: The browser reproduction exposed parent-health inference and cross-station rows
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A differently identified adapter needs an explicit identity mapping, not a guessed fallback

rulings.decision: Expose server evaluation/expiry bounds and use monotonic request elapsed time in the UI
rulings.why: An outstanding query must not freeze an old normal label; the browser must not invent sensor TTLs
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Slow transport can conservatively mark data expired earlier, not later

rulings.decision: Do not infer physical clock-reset epochs from indistinguishable old packets
rulings.why: Without independent ordering evidence an old packet could simply be delayed; it must not refresh current state
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An actual device clock reset may remain unusable until trustworthy time is restored; automatic epoch-reset recovery is not claimed

limits: The UI fixture exercises an in-process fake Bus, not a TCP wire simulator, RTU framing, physical serial/RS485 or real hardware.
M5 and real-device sign-off remain pending.
No production devices were connected and no automatic control was exercised.
No new protocol, general Device/Unit rewrite, history backfill, replacement identity migration or platform-wide timer redesign was included.
Existing OPC-UA direct publication and other adapters are not claimed as fully covered by this Modbus-focused slice.
No push or GitHub issue/PR publication was performed. Tickets 03–07 are not started by this work.
